title: Run focused renderer integration sweep for CLI web and desktop
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility wrappers in steam_deals_generator.py still cover current renderer entrypoints after extraction.
CLI, web, and desktop entry scripts import or invoke the generator without renderer-related import errors.
The first cut remains limited to renderers and does not pull cache, adapters, or orchestration into the refactor.

Validation commands recorded and runnable: python3 -m py_compile steam_deals_generator.py steam_deals_web.py steam_tools_desktop.py renderers/*.py; python3 steam_deals_generator.py --help; python3 steam_deals_web.py --help; python3 steam_tools_desktop.py --help
completion_summary: Barrido de integración completado para CLI/web/desktop tras extracción de renderers. Se agregó salida temprana de ayuda en steam_tools_desktop.py para evitar bloqueo con --help. Validaciones ejecutadas: py_compile de entrypoints+renderers y --help en generator/web/desktop.
